I came to know about the CCWJ during Fall of 2019. I was amazed by the work done by its members in the field of welding. I have since been working under the guidance of Patricio Mendez and have been involved in creation of a procedure database for industrial arc welding processes.

## Project

Database creation and Management for Arc Welding Procedures
